description: Brings an app's existing task back to the screen the way Recents does: the activity that was on top comes back (recreated from its saved state if it or its process was destroyed meanwhile) and nothing is added to the task. Unlike launch_app (`am start -n`), which can start the launcher activity on top of a task the user opened from the home screen. Use it to return to an app after HOME in restore scenarios. Returns the top activity and whether it was resumed (false: see get_crashes). Device control.

serial.description: adb serial; default: the session device, or the only ready one.

name: bring_to_front
title: Bring an app back
